stem: When coordinating post-transplant Candida prophylaxis, which timing pattern aligns with standard references?

options.text: Oral or topical nystatin or clotrimazole prophylaxis during the first 3 months post-transplant
Antifungal prophylaxis is never used in the first year after transplant
Candida prophylaxis is required only after 5 years post-transplant
Prophylaxis is limited exclusively to the pretransplant period

explanation.rationale_correct: Candida prophylaxis with oral or topical nystatin or clotrimazole may be used during the first 3 months post-transplant, when receiving higher steroid doses, or when immunosuppression is increased during rejection.

rationale_incorrect.B: Prophylaxis is specifically used in the early post-transplant period rather than being omitted in the first year.
rationale_incorrect.C: Early post-transplant prophylaxis is described rather than deferring prophylaxis until 5 years.
rationale_incorrect.D: Prophylaxis is a post-transplant measure rather than being limited to pretransplant only.

stem: A kidney transplant recipient on tacrolimus develops refractory mucosal candidiasis and is started on oral fluconazole. Which medication-safety step aligns with standard references?

options.text: Monitor tacrolimus levels carefully and adjust the dose as needed during fluconazole therapy
No tacrolimus level monitoring is needed because fluconazole does not affect calcineurin inhibitors
Stop tacrolimus permanently whenever any antifungal is prescribed
Double the tacrolimus dose automatically without laboratory monitoring

explanation.rationale_correct: Fluconazole increases tacrolimus levels, so tacrolimus levels must be monitored carefully and the dose adjusted as needed during fluconazole therapy.

rationale_incorrect.B: Fluconazole specifically increases tacrolimus levels rather than having no interaction.
rationale_incorrect.C: Tacrolimus continues with careful monitoring and dose adjustment rather than being stopped permanently.
rationale_incorrect.D: Dose changes require monitoring and individualized adjustment rather than automatic doubling without labs.

stem: A pediatric solid-organ transplant recipient develops a red pinpoint rash on the buttocks. Which fungal-infection teaching point aligns with standard references?

options.text: Candida may present with a red pinpoint rash of the buttocks or genitalia in pediatrics
Pediatric buttock rashes always indicate bacterial meningitis only
Candida never causes skin findings in pediatric transplant recipients
Red pinpoint rashes exclude fungal infection from the differential

explanation.rationale_correct: Candida presentation may include white plaques in the oropharynx or, in pediatrics, a red pinpoint rash of the buttocks or genitalia along with vaginal discharge and itching.

rationale_incorrect.B: Buttock rash is described as a Candida presentation rather than indicating bacterial meningitis alone.
rationale_incorrect.C: Candida may cause skin findings in pediatric recipients.
rationale_incorrect.D: Red pinpoint rash is consistent with Candida rather than excluding fungal infection.

stem: A coordinator is updating post-transplant fungal-infection teaching. Evaluate the following statements:

elements.text: Candida prophylaxis with nystatin or clotrimazole may be used during the first 3 months post-transplant.
Fluconazole increases tacrolimus levels and requires dose monitoring.
Lungs are the most common primary site of Aspergillus infection.
Aspergillus infections typically occur only in the first week after transplant.

explanation.rationale_correct: Early Candida prophylaxis, fluconazole–tacrolimus interaction monitoring, and pulmonary primacy of Aspergillus infection are supported. Statement IV is false because Aspergillus is described as a later infection occurring 6 months or more post-transplant.

rationale_incorrect.A: Statement III is also true—lungs are the most common primary Aspergillus site.
rationale_incorrect.C: Statement I is also true; statement IV is false.
rationale_incorrect.D: Statement IV is false because Aspergillus timing is later rather than limited to the first week.
